assumptions.choice: Calculate size as int(self.broker.getcash() / self.data.close[0]) on the signal bar.
assumptions.reason: The specification calls for using all available capital for position sizing; dividing available cash by the current close price determines the maximum integer share amount.

assumptions.choice: Place a stop-loss sell order at 98% of the actual executed buy price once the buy order completes.
assumptions.reason: The specification states a stop-loss set at 2% below the entry price, which is accurately determined from order.executed.price in notify_order.

assumptions.choice: Cancel any active stop-loss order and submit a market close order on the first trading day of February.
assumptions.reason: Closing the position on the first trading day of February requires canceling the pending protective stop order to prevent orphaned or duplicate sell orders.
